newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Index falls further on Tallinn bourse.
newsitem.headline: Index falls further on Tallinn bourse.

text.p: The index fell at Estonia's fledgeling bourse on Tuesday amid relatively brisk trade, dealers said.
Overall market volume was 10.3 million kroons and the index continued its recent slump, falling by 0.28 percent to 105.34 kroons.
Hansa Bank accounted for the bulk of market activity at over five million kroons but its closing price eased to 106.65 kroons versus 106.80 kroons on Monday.
"Although the market showed some activity, prices were quite stable," one dealer told Reuters.
Volume on the free market reached five million kroons.
